profile_text.body:
Ambarella Inc. describes itself as a maker of AI vision processors for edge applications. Its website says the company's advanced imaging solutions make cameras smarter by extracting valuable data from high-resolution video streams. The site lists application areas including advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders, and autonomous vehicles.

Ambarella is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, and trades under the ticker AMBA. Its SEC CIK number is 0001280263. California legal exposure records show 281 entries associated with the company. No specific cases or individual product names appear in the available material.
